posts.title: The Magic of Cats
posts.description: This is what I have learned from living with cats. Or perhaps, this is the wisdom of cats that I have observed and would like to practice. Living in the present. Every day is a new day, a new world to explore. I think about this each morning as I look out the window, wondering at the unexpected magic of sunlight filtering through leaves, same window, same trees, yet each day the shapes and colors

posts.title: Review: Inferno, by Boards of Canada
posts.description: Always fun when a favorite artist drops a whole album without warning after many quiet years: in this case, Inferno by Boards of Canada. I heard some things. Going to play the album once more and jot down some unedited thoughts. “Introit”. Mid-century futurist optimism, but it’s weak and lo-fi, and promptly obliterated by an all-consuming crescendo of red noise: “Prophecy At 1420 Mhz”. Everything

posts.title: Me and the Mac at 40
posts.description: The Mac is 40 years old . Like myself, it’s an elder millennial in age and spirit. Time to reflect. My first experience with the Mac was in the middle school computer lab: rows of beige plastic in various flavors of Macintosh LC and Color Classic. In hindsight it was a pretty great lab, well-stocked for a small-town school far from any city and always a decade behind the times. The Macs at the lab
